title: Newlands Resolution
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Newlands Resolution", at revision 1382192780, opens: "The Newlands Resolution, 30 Stat. 750, was a joint resolution passed on July 7, 1898, by the United States Congress to annex the independent Republic of Hawaii, for the purpose of colonizing the island. In 1900, Congress created the Territory of Hawaii." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2341456, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "resolution for U.S. annexation of Hawaii, 1898". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
